notBlind: All target years have already informed development. This is not an independent final test or verified real-time replay. No promotion based only on total-result scores.
rules: Keep all v6 preliminary-tax and income-equalisation forecasts, grants, costs, stocks, demographic/capital parameters, note policies, macro vintages and accounting assumptions. Historical own tax rate equals the reference rate.

Replace the entire inherited tax residual in v6 with a declared settlement forecast. Horizon 1 is the same December circular currentYearSettlementPerCapita for origin+1 multiplied by the opening-ledger population at year-end origin, divided by 1e6.
The year-end count is an explicit proxy for the required November 1 population in the same origin year. Never relabel it as observed November or infer population from tax outcomes.

For horizons 2 and 3 assume current-year settlements equal zero; assume all future prior-year settlement revisions equal zero. These are declared conditional expectations, not observed values or certainty. Original source nulls remain unchanged.

Bind preliminary tax to externalTax and the signed settlement separately to externalTaxSettlement, without multiplying the latter by the local tax rate. The inherited tax residual is zero in this variant; inherited grants remain unchanged.
Keep the existing same-year tax-payment assumption and zero opening net tax receivable. Result scoring does not validate actual cash settlement dates or liquidity forecasts.
Retain every previous forecast and outcome exactly, add both native note-policy variants and their accounting counterparts, and repeat both WIP alternatives at both origins with missing opening WIP.

Score combined current settlement plus prior-year revision, preliminary tax, entire tax revenue, grants, personnel, tax-and-grants, net cost, finance net and full result. Retain direct source targets for current settlement and prior revision separately. Use the same 12 cases; report MAE, bias, RMSE and leave-one-target-out stability.

Report first-year direct settlement sensitivity s*deltaN/1e6 for the preregistered -1000,-100,0,100,1000-person differences. These are hypothetical errors in the population proxy, not measured error bounds, confidence intervals or full-result intervals; later financing effects are not included in this coefficient.

No parameter fitting, score-selected horizons, blending, changed source vintages, outcome cleaning, promotion or claim of independent final validation. The prior review approved the mechanism to test, not its eventual accuracy.
